s: Din hayyotze chutz lattechum ubo t' seipim: mi sheyyatza chutz lattechum apillu amma achat, lo yiknos lihyot kibne hair, veen lo ella d' ammot meamidat raglayv lekol ruach (sheyyirtzeh), kemo shennitbaer besimman shtz"v. Veap al pi shettechum zeh shel d' ammot shennatenu lo chakamim kesheyyatza chutz lattechum hu mubla betok techum alpayim sheyyatza mimmennu, en hablaat techumim ellu moelet lomar: kevan shenniknas birshut betok techum sheyyatza mimmennu — sheyyihyeh keillu lo yatza mimmennu kelal, ella im ken yatza mimmennu birshut, kegon lehatztzil nepashot, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman t"z. Vehu haddin im yatza shello ledato, kegon shehotziuhu nokrim o ezeh ones acher — moelet hablaat techumin ellu sheyyihyeh keillu lo yatza mittechumo meolam, veyesh lo alpayim lekol ruach mehammaqom sheshshabat bo:
Hayeta raglo achat tok hattechum veraglo achat chutz lattechum — yikkanes lihyot kibne iro, shekkevan sheen chutz lattechum ella raglo achat, adayin rubbo betok hattechum:

Mi sheqqiddesh alayv hayyom vehu chutz lattechum hair, apillu amma achat — lo yiknos lihyot kibne hair, veeno mehallek ella alpayim amma lekol ruach mimmaqom sheqqiddesh alayv hayyom (veyakol lahalok bair g' ammot, shehare yesh lo alpayim chutz mid' ammot shehen meqom shebitato, kemo shennitbaer besimman shtz"v), ayyen leqamman besimman t"ch:

Mi shehipliga sepinato bayyam — mehallek et kullah, hoil veshabat baavir mechitztzot. Veim nipchat dopne hassepina beshabbat, im hi mehalleket — mehallek et kullah, veim hi omedet — eno mehallek bah ella d' ammot. Veim beroshah en lah mechitztzot asara, veyesh beqarqaitah lachaqoq ulehashlimah laasara — mehallek et kullah: mi sheyyatza chutz lattechum shello ladaat — muttar laasot lo mechitztza shel bene adam sheerebu leoto ruach vikolim lelek sham, veyaaseh sebibayv kemo mechitztza, veyikkanes benehem (ad tok hattechum o ad pachot mid' ammot letok hattechum, shemmishsham yakol lelek gam belo mechitztza letok hattechum). Vekevan shenniknas tok hattechum birshut, mippene shekkol haheqqep shettok hammechitztza naasa lo ked' ammot — hare zeh keillu lo yatza kelal mittechumo, kevan sheyyatza shello ladaat. Vehu shello yedeu otam shennaaset mehem hammechitztza shelleshem kak niqreu, kemo shennitbaer besimman shs"b. Vaapillu im haheqqep shebbetok mechitztza zo hu yoter mealpayim amma — nechshab kullo ked' ammot lezeh sheyyatza chutz lattechum, ap al pi sheeno nechshab ked' ammot lemi shello yatza chutz lattechum, hoil venaaset hammechitztza beshabbat, kemo shennitbaer besimman t"g (ayyen sham hattaam). Abal im yatza chutz lattechum ladaat — asur lelek apillu betok mechitztza yoter mid' ammot, kemo sheyyitbaer:

Mi shehotziuhu nokrim chutz lattechum, o sheyyatza meatzmo al yede sheachazattu ruach raa venitrepa dato, o sheyyatza al yede shear kol ones, o sheshshagag veyatza — en lo ella d' ammot. Hecheziruhu letok hattechum — keillu lo yatza, vahare kol hair lo ked' ammot kebattechilla, vechutza lah alpayim amma lekol ruach. Abal im chazar ladaat letok hattechum — en lo ella d' ammot. Veken im apillu chazar shello ladaat, ella sheyyatza ladaat. Umikkol maqom, im chazar leiro — kol hair chashuba lo ked' ammot im hi muqqepet mechitztzot ledira, vaapillu im yatza ladaat vechazar ladaat, hoil veshabat baavir mechitztzoteha. Ella sheasur latzet chutza lah:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshechazar lair sheshshabat bah. Abal beir acheret — en lo ella d' ammot apillu muqqepet mechitztzot ledira. Vaapillu bechatzer o babbayit en lo ella d' ammot, veen kullo nechshab lo ked' ammot, hoil velo shabat baavir mechitztzot ellu. Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesheyyatza chutz lattechum ladaat, o shenniknas ladaat beir zo o bebayit zeh shehen chutz led' ammot shennatenu lo chakamim. Abal hotziuhu nokrim chutz lattechum, unetanuhu hem bair hammuqqepet ledira, o bedir o besahar o bimara (shehi ledira o sheen bah yoter mibbet satayim), o shenneenas bishar ones latzet chutz lattechum velikkanes leechad mimmeqomot ellu, o sheshshagag veyatza chutz lattechum veniknas leechad meellu, venizkar vehu betoko — mehallek et kullo, shekkullo nechshab lo ked' ammot hoil umuqqap mechitztzot ledira, ap al pi shello shabat baaviro, kevan shehu anus:

Veken mi shebba bispina beshabbat, veniknesa hassepina letok ir hammuqqepet ledira — mehallek et kullah. Veen zeh keyatza ladaat, kevan shehaya kebar bassepina mibbeod yom, shehi sheat hetter latzet chutz lattechum, ubeshabbat hotziattu hassepina chutz lattechum, vehu lo asa kelum. Abal im lo niknesa leir hammuqqepet [le]dira — asur latzet mehassepina im hayeta bemaqom lematta mi' tepachim mishshenniknas hashshabbat, vehipliga meoto maqom yoter mealpayim, kemo shennitbaer besimman t"d. Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshehaya bassepina mibbeod yom (velo yatza mimmenna layyabbasha mishshenniknas hashshabbat, o sheyyatza mimmenna bemaqom shello haya epshar lo lehishshaer shamma ad lemotzae shabbat, shehassepina shel nokrim velo yamtinu alayv vehutzrak lachazor lassepina, shezzehu anus hu bachazirato lassepina ubitziato bah chutz lattechum meoto maqom). Abal ellu sheqqonim shebita bassepina, veyotzeim mimmenna lebattehem lalun, ulemachar niknasim lassepina umapligim — hare zeh keyotze ladaat, veim niknas lair hammuqqepet [le]dira enah chashuba lo ked' ammot, kevan shello shabat baavir mechitztzoteha. Veasur latzet mehassepina lair ap im lo hayeta leolam lematta mi' tepachim, lepi sheap im timtze lomar sheen techumim lemala mi' tepachim velo qana shebita ben hashshemashot keshehaya bassepina, mikkol maqom hare qana shebita achar kak bebeto. Abal mikkol maqom hassepina kullah nechshebet lo ked' ammot, apillu im hayeta mehalleket hakkol lematta mi' tepachim, veyakol lehallek bekullah ap leachar shehipliga chutz lattechum, hoil veshabat baavir mechitztzoteha. Abal asur latzet missepina lispina. Umikkol maqom yakol likkanes lispina qetanna laasot tzerakayv velachazor lispina gedola, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman t"v. Veim nipchatu dopne hassepina beshabbat, veenan gebohim y' tepachim — eno mehallek bah yoter mid' ammot, vaapillu im lo yatza mimmenna mishshenniknas hashshabbat, ella shehayeta bemaqom echad lematta mi' tepachim mishshenniknas hashshabbat vehipliga meoto maqom yoter mealpayim, shekkevan sheen lah mechitztzot — en kullah ked' ammot. (Vaapillu bemaqom shehi omedet lemala mi' tepachim eno mehallek bah yoter mid' ammot, shello ameru "en techumin lemala measara" ella behilluk hassepina al pene hammayim, shehu domeh liqpitza baavir veeno niqra hilluk, kemo shennitbaer besimman t"d. Abal hilluk haadam betok hassepina — hilluk hu, kemo hamhallek baaretz. Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshehi omedet. Abal keshehi mehalleket — mehallek et kullah bekol inyan, mippene shetterem sheyyaspiq lehallek (d' ammot) apillu pesia achat, notalto hassepina mid' ammot ellu umannichato bed' ammot acherot al korcho, veyesh lo sham d' ammot acherot, kemo mi shehotziuhu nokrim mid' ammot unetanuhu bed' ammot acherot, sheyyesh lo sham d' ammot, veken meoto d' ammot led' ammot acherot, veken leolam). Veim beemtzaah yesh lah mechitztzot asara uberoshah en lah, kegon shehi amuqqa beemtzaitah uberoshah hi meshuppaat veholeket kelappe mala qetzat, kederek sepinot qetannot — ap al pi ken kullah ked' ammot apillu kesheomedet, mippene shekkullah reshut hayyachid, hi sherasheha hem kechore reshut hayyachid shenniddonim kirshut hayyachid, kemo shennitbaer besimman shm"h. Vaapillu im gam beemtzaitah enah amuqqa asara, ella sheyyesh bah lachaqoq lehashlimah laasara, dehaynu obi hannesarim shebbeqarqaitah sheyyesh bah kede lehashlim gobhah laasara — hare hem mitztorpim lehashlimah venaaset kullah ked' ammot, shehare yesh lah mechitztzot shehen gebohot asara mibbechutz, sheobi qarqaitah shemmin hatztzedadim kelappe chutz mitztarep hu im hammechitztzot asher alayv (lepi sheap obi zeh shemmin hatztzedadim roim oto keillu omed kimchitztza al gabbe qarqaitah, mishshum torat "gud asseq", kemo shennitbaer besimman shm"h). Vahare zeh domeh lechatzer sheqqarqaitah gaboah mechatzer acheret h' tepachim, vekotel gaboah h' tepachim mapsiq benehem, veen kotel zeh gaboah y' tepachim ella lechatzer hannemuka abal lehaggeboha eno gaboah y', veap al pi ken hi mechitztza gemura lishtehen, kemo shennitbaer besimman sha"b, hoil sheap lechatzer haggaboah hu gaboah y' mibbechutz. Veod, shekkevan shebbeqarqaitah yesh kede lachaqoq lehashlimah laasara — anu roim keillu hu chaquq, ki yesh mi sheomer shebbekol maqom omerim "choqeqim lehashlim", veyesh lismok al dibrehem leinyan techumin, shehalaka kedibre hammeqel bahem:

Im niknas lispina al daat shello lehaplig chutz lattechum, veyotza hassepina chutz lattechum vechozra laachoreha lannamal shehipliga mishsham — hare hu keillu lo yatza, shennaasa kemo shehotziuhu nokrim chutz lattechum vehecheziruhu litchumo. Vaapillu im niknas al menat lehaplig, ella shenniknas mibbeod yom velo yatza mimmenna mishshenniknas hashshabbat, ap al pi shehayeta lematta mi' tepachim, sheqqana sham shebita, mikkol maqom im achar kak chozra letok techum hammaqom sheqqana sham shebita — hare hu keillu lo yatza, shekkevan shenniknas lah meereb shabbat, hare zeh keyotze shello ladaat kemo shennitbaer:

Perot shehotziam chutz lattechum vehecheziram litchumam, apillu bemezid — hare hem keillu lo yatzeu. Mah taam? Anusim hem bitziatam ubachazaratam. Vahare kol hair lahem ked' ammot kebattechilla vechutza lah alpayim lekol ruach, im hu yom tob shehahotzaa mereshut lirshut mutteret bo, veim hu shabbat — muttarim al kol panim baakila bimqomam. Vaapillu leoto yisrael shehecheziram letzorko en dinam kishar dabar habba michutz lattechum, sheasur lemi shehuba bishbilo, hoil uperot ellu hayu kebar bitchum zeh beshabbat zo. Vaapillu hammachazir atzmo, sheasa issur — en qonesin oto shello yoklem beshabbat. (Veeno domeh lehamasser perot beshabbat, sheqqanesu oto shello yokal mehem, lepi sheal yede asiyyat haissur nitqenu laakila, shello hayu reuyim kelal miqqodem leken, mippene shehem tebel. Abal perot ellu hayu reuyim lo keshehaya immahem chutz lattechum, velo hoil lo kelum laakilatam bemah shehecheziram litchumam, veeno neheneh min haissur baakilato otam. Veeno domeh lehambashshel beshabbat perot hanneekalim chayyim sheasurim, mippene sheasa bahem issur shel tora, abal techumin hem middibre soperim). Vekol zeman shello huchzeru vehem chutz lattechum, im hotziam beshogeg — muttarim leoklam veasur letaltelam chutz mid' ammot, veim hotziam bemezid — asurin apillu lemi shello hotziam bishbilo. Veeno domeh leba michutz lattechum al yede nokri, shemmuttar lemi shello huba bishbilo, shekkevan shennaasa haissur al yede yisrael, hechemiru yoter leesor lekol adam. Veap al pi ken muttar letaltelam tok d' ammot, veen lahem din muqtzeh, ap al pi sheenam reuyim baakila leshum adam miyyisrael. Kevan sheen issuran ella mishshum qenas, lo ratzu liqnos ella baakila velo betiltul:
